title: Unique Buttery Irish Fennel Dumplings
description: A delicious and quick Irish dish featuring fennel bulb, these dumplings are buttery and shattering, perfect for a low-glycemic diet. They can be prepared in no time and are great as a side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped fennel, flour, melted butter, eggs, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Gradually add the chicken broth to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings to the pot.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and drain off any excess water.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
